items.text:
1. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA U (Eligibility only, no signs)
100 block of Stillman Street, 475 4th Street and 550-560 Bryant Street (Supervisor District 6) (Requires
approval by the SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents of the 100 block of Stillman
Street between 3rd and 4th Streets, including 475 4th Street and 550-560 Bryant Street so they can
purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park within RPP Area U. Note: 101 and 147 Stillman
Street are already in RPP Area U.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
